content.title: KATSEYE's WILD Hit No. 1 — 170,000 Units and the New Global Girl-Group Math
content.excerpt: KATSEYE's WILD opened at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 with 170,000 units. Its sales-heavy mix shows how global girl groups are scaling.

facts.claim: WILD debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard 200.
WILD opened with 170,000 equivalent album units for the week ending August 20.
The total included 145,000 traditional sales, 24,500 SEA units, and 500 TEA units.
The 24,500 SEA units corresponded to 26.95 million on-demand audio streams.
WILD was released on August 14 as KATSEYE's third EP through HYBE x Geffen, with five songs on the regular edition.
BEAUTIFUL CHAOS debuted at No. 4 and WILD is KATSEYE's second top-10 and third overall Billboard 200 entry.
WILD became the fourth album by an all-woman group to top the Billboard 200 since 2020.
WILD reached No. 2 in the United Kingdom.
KATSEYE's formation context includes Dream Academy and the HYBE/Geffen partnership.
The article's sales-led interpretation and post-headline conversion implications are analysis, not reported chart facts.
